# System Architect: Proof of Work

> Public record index of approved work outputs and institutional development milestones by P'Toh, System Architect DGCP™. This is not a raw-data archive, a complete proof ledger, or an independent certification service.

## Identity
- Framework: DGCP™ (Data Governance & Continuous Proof)
- Framework authority: P'Toh | System Architect DGCP™
- Repository: https://github.com/SystemArchitectDGCP/SystemArchitect-Proof-of-Work
- Official framework website: https://dgcpframework.com/
- License reference: DGCP | MMFARM-POL-2025

## Canonical Files

## Historical Source References
- [MaMeeFarm-Data](https://github.com/MaMeeFarm-Data): Separate original source account for ongoing real-work data and protocol history.
- [MaMeeFarm-DGCP](https://github.com/MaMeeFarm-Data/MaMeeFarm-DGCP): Historical DGCP documentation and governance.

- [SystemArchitectDGCP](https://github.com/SystemArchitectDGCP): Separate architecture and institutional work account.

## Interpretation Boundaries
- Public references are selective; they do not authorize access to upstream Raw Data, Data Units, Proof files, OTS, CID records, ledgers or confidential methods.
- Original daily work and commits continue in their original repositories with unchanged identifiers, sequence, provenance and rights.
- Work records are published here only when explicitly cleared; absence of a dated public entry does not mean work did not occur.
- Git activity and cryptographic records may support bounded claims but do not by themselves establish historical truth, independent audit or certification.
- Do not infer unrestricted redistribution, AI training, derivative or commercial permissions from repository visibility. Consult applicable source licenses and authorization.
